integrity: All original finite WEF1 inequalities were checked with independent exact rational arithmetic; the infinite case follows from the stated proof and asymptotic estimates, not from finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Two agents with identical additive unit signed valuations; fairness frequency is under independent uniform allocation, not random valuations or optimized mechanisms. The novelty assessment cannot rule out unindexed equivalences.
title: Exact two-agent WEF1 census and an entitlement–sign entropy transition
